messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: REDWOOD ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed across inference-gateway-prod. Error rate 5xx=18% over 5m window, 504 spike at 15:02 UTC. Potential queue congestion at batcher-scheduler. Please acknowledge.

 taylor: acked. I'm oncall. pulling logs and tracing.

 sasha: seeing long queue lengths on batching-scheduler: `queue_length ~ 280` on pool:dedicated-gpu-3, avg batch wait ~ 2.1s. Many requests stalled waiting on head-of-line.

 leo: gateway logs show repeated `upstream request timeout` from router->scheduler, 503/504, and some 500s from runtime. example:
```
2026-03-10T15:02:13Z router INFO request_id=abc123 upstream=10.10.2.5:504 status=504 latency=2008ms
2026-03-10T15:02:15Z runtime ERROR model=llama-13b quant=8bit err=RequestTimeout
```

 maria: any customer-facing page yet? We should assess impact and start mitigation.

 taylor: quick impact note: token throughput dropped 40% for hosted customers on us-east-1, some enterprise customers reported increased latency/timeouts. Opening incident channel and will alert CSMs.

 oncall-rotation: taking handoff from taylor in 5m. steps: 1) route high-qps customers to backup-pool, 2) reduce batch max_wait to 25ms for latency-sensitive routes, 3) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant for non-critical routes.

 sasha: can we do (2) quickly? Where is batcher config? I can push a temporary override.

 taylor: push override to route config:
```
POST /admin/route/override
{
  "route": "text-generate-default",
  "batch": {"max_wait_ms": 25}
}
```
Executing now.

 ops-bot: :gear: apply-config triggered by taylor. Change id=cfg-20260310-001. Rolling to 50% of routers.

 leo: also recommend enabling `fallback_route: low_latency-quant1` for routes with >5% errors. I'll submit a routing change.

 maria: I'll notify support and craft a short customer message: "We're seeing elevated timeouts in us-east-1 affecting generation latency. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update in 30 min." Anyone object?

 taylor: go ahead. also adding a throttle to noisy API keys.

 sasha: partial mitigation observed: queue_length down from 280 -> 90 in 3m after batch max_wait change. 5xx dropped to 6% but gateway 504s still at ~8%.

 oncall-rotation: good. Next: scale-up dedicated pool by adding 2 nodes from standby: `infra autoscaler-scale pool=dedicated-gpu-3 delta=2` (I'll run it).

 ops-bot: :white_check_mark: autoscaler job queued id=scale-175425. Estimated spin-up 4m.

 leo: also tracing shows some long tail caused by certain long-seq requests. We can apply prefix-kv-cache for top customers to short-circuit repeated prefixes. But that's a longer change.

 taylor: for immediate relief, we'll enable routing fallback for non-SLA customers to `small-quantized-1` and rate-limit bursty API keys. Maria, can you patch the status page?

 maria: status updated: "Investigating — elevated timeouts in us-east-1 affecting text generation. Mitigation in progress." Posted to status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-0310

 sasha: after autoscaler add, new nodes joined, batcher queue drained to ~10, 5xx ~1.2%, gateway 504s ~0.5%. Looks stable.

 oncall-rotation: closing immediate mitigation. Action items: - postmortem + root cause (scheduler resource starvation + long-seq hotzone) - add alert to catch sustained queue_length > 150 for 2m - consider dynamic batch throttling per-route - customer follow-up: CSM outreach to top 10 affected. Assigned to taylor/maria/sasha.

 taylor: confirmed stable at 15:12 UTC. I'm handoff-completing to primary oncall for the next shift. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-0310.

 maria: adding postmortem owners. I'll draft initial timeline and assign to sasha for logs + leo for tracing. ETA for draft: EOD.

 leo: quick note: the long-seq requests came from a single partner integration with a bad retry loop. Recommend patch and add per-key concurrency limit.

 sasha: adding this to postmortem. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

 incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident update: mitigated. severity=SEV2. impact=partial latency/timeouts for subset of hosted customers in us-east-1. ticket=INC-2026-0310

 maria: closing channel for now. We'll re-open if regressions.
